items.operation_reason: New invariant introduced by the initial implementation.
items.title: Confirm usage-limit exhaustion is review-required
items.action: Open src/Responses/ValidationResult.php and inspect the synthetic limitExceeded() result.
items.expected_result: decision is review, reason_code is LIMIT_EXCEEDED, isAllowed() is false, and needsReview() is true.
items.why_it_matters: Quota exhaustion must never silently approve traffic.
preconditions: Use the fixture source revision fixture-initial.

items.operation_reason: New public client entry point requires explicit compatibility verification.
items.title: Confirm the validation client signature remains compatible
items.action: Inspect validate() in src/ValidationClient.php and compare its required parameters with the documented compatibility fixture.
items.expected_result: Existing required arguments remain unchanged and the method returns a ValidationResult instance.
items.why_it_matters: A silent signature break would fail existing SDK consumers before they can evaluate a result.

items.operation_reason: New public documentation must be checked against the implemented result vocabulary.
items.title: Confirm validation documentation matches runtime values
items.action: Open docs/validation.md and compare the allowed, denied, and review examples with ValidationResult.php.
items.expected_result: Every documented decision and reason-code example exists in the runtime contract and no example contains a credential.
items.why_it_matters: Consumers copy documentation examples directly, so drift creates integration errors and unsafe assumptions.
